population_semantics: complete deterministic finite factorial population, not a probabilistic sample

primary_estimand.name: marginal_policy_success_proportion
primary_estimand.definition: For each recovery policy, the exact number of trusted_recovery_success=1 observations divided by all 864 equally weighted frozen factor positions for that policy.

primary_contrast.name: P3_minus_P1_success_risk_difference
primary_contrast.definition: Exact finite-population difference in marginal trusted-recovery success proportions, P3 minus P1, expressed as a fraction and percentage-point difference.
primary_contrast.rationale: P3 adds the deterministic contact-budget guard to staged-cutover semantics, making P1 the closest policy comparator for isolating the modeled contact-awareness contribution.

supporting_policy_contrasts: all six unordered pairwise policy success risk differences

cryptographic_profile_estimands.paired_pattern_check: Within each identical policy/regime/disruption/phase_offset/deadline position, record whether success across PROFILE_512_44, PROFILE_768_65, PROFILE_1024_87 is non-increasing as standardized cryptographic-object size increases; report counts only, without causal or physical-performance interpretation.

secondary_endpoint_summaries.recovery_completion_slot: Among trusted-recovery successes only, report exact n and arithmetic mean as integer sum/count plus median, minimum, and maximum by policy; do not reinterpret slots as physical time.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.contacts_consumed: Report n, integer sum, exact mean as sum/count, median, minimum, and maximum by policy over all observations.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.cryptographic_bytes_transferred: Report n, integer sum, exact mean as sum/count, median, minimum, and maximum by policy over all observations; bytes are modeled cryptographic-object transfer budget only.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.transition_attempts: Report n, integer sum, exact mean as sum/count, median, minimum, and maximum by policy over all observations.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.legacy_exposure_slots: Report n, integer sum, exact mean as sum/count, median, minimum, and maximum by policy over all observations; logical slots only.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.control_unavailable_slots: Report n, integer sum, exact mean as sum/count, median, minimum, and maximum by policy over all observations; logical slots only.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.dual_epoch_overlap_slots: Report n, integer sum, exact mean as sum/count, median, minimum, and maximum for P2; verify the endpoint is zero for non-P2 policies; logical policy-state slots only.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.rollback_invoked: Report exact count and proportion by policy.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.stale_epoch_acceptance: Report exact count and proportion by policy.
secondary_endpoint_summaries.terminal_state: Report exact count and proportion for every terminal-state label by policy.

heterogeneity_reporting.rule: For each prespecified P3-minus-P1 stratum, report exact numerator/denominator success proportions for both policies and exact risk difference. Report sign reversals or zero contrasts descriptively; do not perform significance testing.

validation_requirements: SHA-256 of canonical_observations.csv must equal the frozen canonical hash before analysis
the full frozen Cartesian factor structure must be present exactly once
each policy must contain exactly 864 positions
independent statistical implementation must not import the primary statistical implementation
primary and independent machine-readable findings must be exactly equal after canonical JSON serialization

inference_policy.reason: The frozen object of inference is the entire deterministic finite population of modeled positions rather than a random sample from a superpopulation.

missing_value_policy.recovery_completion_slot: may be absent only when trusted_recovery_success=0; success-only summary uses observed successful completion slots
missing_value_policy.other_prespecified_secondary_endpoints: missing prohibited unless explicitly encoded by the frozen model contract

claim_boundary: All findings remain bounded to modeled logical contact/recovery behavior and NIST-standardized cryptographic-object byte budgets. No spacecraft latency, RF throughput, onboard compute, energy, flight, ground-station, or operational CCSDS/PQC performance claim is permitted.
